repairs: Updated controller, equipment ownership, menu-index and save/cheat expectations for the requested behavior; corrected synthetic settings, aircraft and audio-clock fixtures.
Shuffled whole-map appearance sampling and separated it from local refill to avoid distance-culling unrelated global samples.
All-map checks exposed refill using the vehicle radius. Refill now chooses eligible nearby pedestrian nodes and an assertion confirms immediate culling retains them.
visuals: Decorative frame expanded, retracted and removed at 1920x1080, 1280x720 and 2560x1080.
Seven-item equipment page including the purchased Remote Taser, with a shortened description.
limitations: No interactive gameplay, physical-controller or listening check.
NullRHI visual-only cases may be no-ops; the two UI cases were also run with D3D12 offscreen rendering.
Concurrent compressed-music/release changes were preserved. This task did not publish a release or replace the installed game.
